verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no documented sandbox or test environment that is isolated from production data. Several items are near misses that earn no credit. Running separate self-hosted instances via Docker, npm or Helm is a user-side workaround. The secure code-execution feature is an adjacent sandboxed-execution capability. The free public demo at chat.librechat.ai is a try-it instance, not a sandbox counterpart to a user's own production deployment.
